definitions.ask: How should prompt bead IDs be colored once they are underlined?
definitions.why: Status color shows at a glance whether a bead you reference is still live

choices.label: Each ID takes its bead's status color (in-progress gold, closed green, open blue)
One theme-derived bead color, matching the glossary and repo-name siblings

definitions.ask: What should Ctrl+] open when the cursor is on a bead ID?
definitions.why: Every bead has a detail document; many beads (tasks, flags) have no plan file

choices.label: The full bead detail document in the pager, with followable bead links
The bead's plan file in $EDITOR, falling back to the pager when it has no plan
